input.prompt: Photorealistic concept render of a heavy humanoid combat robot boxer, full body, three-quarter view, standing in a fighting stance. Physically plausible engineering: visible rotary actuators at shoulders, elbows, hips and knees, exposed hydraulic pistons on the forearms, braided cables and hoses, bolted AR500 steel armor plates with chipped yellow and black hazard paint, machined aluminum frame, a boxy armored head with a narrow glowing orange visor slit, a separate neck joint. Massive fists. Dark studio background, rim light, subtle floor reflection. Industrial, weighty, real, like a robot that could actually be built. No text.

Photorealistic concept render of a squat, wide biped combat robot with a huge hydraulic overhead hammer on its right arm and a thick riveted shield on its left arm, full body, three-quarter view. Short powerful legs with large hip actuators, a low sensor head tucked between the shoulders, visible hydraulic reservoir tank and pressure lines on its back, gauges, oil-stained gunmetal steel, scuffed red accents. Dark studio background, dramatic rim light. Weighty and real, like a machine that could be fabricated. No text.

Photorealistic concept render of a four-legged combat robot, low and aggressive like a steel hyena, side three-quarter view. Wedge-shaped armored front, a hydraulic crushing jaw at the front, a sensor mast head on a short articulated neck, legs built from machined aluminum links with exposed quasi-direct-drive actuators at every joint, rubber foot pads, cable harnesses, weathered olive drab paint with scratches and bare metal edges. Dark studio background, rim light. Physically plausible, weighty. No text.

Photorealistic concept render of a heavy wheeled combat robot with a massive horizontal spinning bar weapon in front, two short articulated grabber arms with hydraulic claws, a small rotating turret sensor head on top, four chunky solid rubber wheels, thick titanium and hardened steel armor, heat-blued metal, orange and white racing livery that is scratched and dented. Three-quarter view, dark studio background, rim lighting. Real engineering, weighty. No text.

Photorealistic concept render of a lean, fast humanoid combat robot kickboxer, full body, in a high kick pose. Long legs of titanium and carbon fiber, exposed compact actuators at each joint with visible gear housings, thin armor panels, a sleek angular head with twin cyan optical sensors, cable runs along the limbs, matte white with electric cyan accents and scuffs. Dark studio background, rim light. Physically plausible and lightweight but strong. No text.

Photorealistic concept render of a tall heavyweight humanoid combat robot with a visible spinning gyroscopic stabilizer wheel housed in a caged glowing core in its chest, full body, three-quarter view. Oversized forearms with pneumatic piston fists, thick legs with large knee actuators, a heavy domed head on an exposed neck joint, riveted chrome and black steel plates, smoke-stained exhaust vents on the back. Dark studio background, rim light. Weighty, real, industrial. No text.

Cinematic wide photograph of two heavy metal combat robots fighting inside an eight-sided chain-link cage fighting arena, black padded posts, stained canvas mat with oil spills and scattered bolts, sparks flying from a punch, thin smoke haze lit by hard overhead broadcast lights, dark crowd silhouettes, sense of immense weight and force, gritty realism, shallow depth of field

A clean design sheet showing the same humanoid combat robot six times side by side in six different paint and material skins: factory fresh gunmetal with yellow hazard stripes; mirror chrome; matte military olive with stencil numbers; candy red racing livery with white number decals; rusted scrapyard patchwork of mismatched plates; black carbon fiber with neon cyan edge lights. Photorealistic renders, full body front view, neutral grey studio background, even lighting. No other text.
